acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce under controlled load (for example -count=N with parallel store packages) or record that it cannot be reproduced after a bounded attempt.
If reproduced, find the cause (timeout, ordering or state) and fix it so the test passes under the same load, with the reproduction retained as evidence.
body: Suspected flake, not confirmed. Observed 2026-10-05 in the #501 lane (branch claude/v1-0698-note-history at 46badf47, corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163): one ./internal/tasks/store/ run of 1648 s with several other agents loading the host failed TestCALV0074_HostSwitchAndRollback with "stranded implement: native transition refused ... MALFORMED". Run alone with -run, it passed at head (22.6 s) and at base d524530f (20.8 s); the branch adds only a new file to that package. Expected: pass regardless of load. Actual: one failure under load. Related load-sensitivity: V1-0724, V1-0779. Probably the same root cause as V1-0771 (fake-host program tests refused 'MALFORMED: transaction: program transition' under load, TestCALV0075/0077); fix both together or close this as a duplicate once V1-0771's cause is known.
title: tests (suspected flake): tasks/store TestCALV0074_HostSwitchAndRollback fails "stranded implement: native transition refused ... MALFORMED" under host load
